title: Smaller fan for cooling needs…average
text:
Smaller fan for cooling needs…average. [[VIDEOID:bb66cb4c2b63e43ea92e8dac34dc1d0b]] This is a smaller size fan with some nice features and some not so. The fan is extremely light and not heavy duty at all. The plastic is so thin and feels so cheap. The magnetic remote holder on the floor is so odd. Who wants to bend over to pick up a remote. And all the touch buttons are on the floor base. You can use your toes to activate them. But some features require more scrolling. I like how the fan rotates horizontally and vertically, but that was the only function I really liked. In my option, this fan has some potential, but it’s not there yet. Also, it needs an upgrade on better materials. An average fan with an extraordinary price point.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
